responsibility: This module is GCC’s integration layer for the Go language frontend (`gccgo`), covering how GNU Go is registered, configured, built, invoked, and connected to GCC’s generic frontend, diagnostic, driver, and backend infrastructure. Its core language-hook and backend bridge files create the Go frontend state, implement Go-specific `lang_hooks`, map frontend IR, types, expressions, source locations, and diagnostics onto GCC trees, linemaps, and the diagnostic system, and lower Go programs into GCC’s middle-end while handling Go export data, builtins, and runtime-related semantics such as unsafe aliasing and exception behavior. Surrounding files define the Go-specific command-line options and driver specs, rewrite link and compile commands for `gccgo` and libgo, and provide build-system and documentation support, making this module the root of GCC’s Go-language support rather than the language-independent Go frontend or runtime library itself.
